ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Site__c, "QSG"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(E) Replacement"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(FAI) First Article Inspec"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(FAT) First Article Test"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(FIM) Free Issue Material"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(FLP) First Lot Production"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(M) Sample"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(NRM) Norm"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(RW) ReWork"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(S) Series"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(TBA) To Be Advised"), ISPICKVAL(Usage__c, "(Z01) FOC under Warranty")) && NOT(ISBLANK(EUS_Quantity__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: EUS Quantity Field is not Required
